patterns: APPSC asks Kakatiya builder/issuer matches: tanks (Kesari Samudram), inscriptions (Sanigaram, Anumakonda, Bayyaram, Motupalli) to rulers.
Statement-type APPSC items test titles and religion: Prola I = Arigajakesari (trap: 'Arikesari'), Beta II initiated into Saivism by Rameswara Pandita, Prataparudra and the Nayankara system.
Simple items: capital = Orugallu (Warangal); Rudrama Devi's victories over Pandyas, Gangas, Seunas.
APPSC keys on this topic contain slips; app notes should follow the fact-consistent reading and flag key conflicts.
App MCQs are dense and much deeper (feudatory titles, Velanati wars, dates) than the PYQs; several cite answer keys rather than facts.
